script_system.script_relationship: Chinese display lettering establishes identity; Latin is narrow, calm and vertically or horizontally subordinate.
script_system.type_family_behavior: Organic irregular display lettering is balanced by restrained serif-like bilingual support and quiet body copy.
script_system.language_hierarchy: Chinese display title first, still-life second, Chinese labels and Latin/body support third.

title_architecture.statement: Four large Chinese glyphs use unequal scale, width, vertical position and spacing to occupy the upper field as an asymmetric visual object rather than a normal text box.

glyph_mechanisms.statement: Visible stroke-width contrast, dry/ink-like terminals, irregular character mass and optical counter adjustment create controlled handmade energy.
glyph_mechanisms.uncertainty: Exact glyph outlines remain brand-bound; transferability is behavior-level only.

hierarchy_mechanisms.statement: The display title dominates, the still-life and side rail counterbalance it, and the lower Chinese/English labels plus paragraph establish restrained secondary and tertiary reads.
hierarchy_mechanisms.uncertainty: The exact count of four tags is production-bound.

layout_coupling.statement: Title strokes, ingredient uprights, vessel silhouette, side rail and metadata axes share vertical/diagonal alignments; text and still life jointly construct the composition.

evidence_pointer.region: title field, still life, right rail and lower metadata

color_material_binding.statement: Muted olive-charcoal lettering sits within a warm matte-mineral field; low saturation and soft contrast keep the large title authoritative without promotional harshness.
color_material_binding.uncertainty: Exact olive/beige values and paper grain are not invariants.

failure_modes.statement: Substituting a clean generic font, equal baseline, centered title or empty beige background would erase the asymmetric title object, active whitespace and editorial cadence.
failure_modes.uncertainty: Requires transfer validation; current causal status remains hypothesis.

figma_producibility.rationale: The asymmetric title-object depends on approved expressive glyph artwork; Figma must not create it from zero.
Editorial paragraph needs exact copy, editable reflow and spelling verification.
Content tags are replaceable and must remain correct.
Functional rail copy stays live; only an approved display sub-asset may be vector.
Latin spelling and bilingual alignment must be deterministic.
The editorial label rhythm must support future content transfer.
